issues.description: Task 'Aufgabe 06' in problem_statement.md requires counting Wanderwege that lead to Gemeinden with more than 500000 male inhabitants (condition: einwohner_m > 500000). The reference solution in solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql contains the opposite condition in the WHERE clause (AND einwohner_m < 500000). This contradiction between the problem statement and the provided solution will cause the reference answer to produce incorrect results and will confuse students who compare their queries or rely on the solution for validation.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql so the WHERE clause matches the task requirement. Replace the condition 'AND einwohner_m < 500000' with 'AND Gemeinde.einwohner_m > 500000' (including the table prefix for clarity). Update any tests or expected outputs that depend on the current incorrect condition.
